description: This file contains a utility class `StringUtils` with static methods for string manipulation, including conversion from camelCase to snake_case, transforming class names into translation labels, and splitting camelCase strings into components. It also includes a check to prevent direct script access.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string transformations related to naming conventions and translation label generation.

methods.name: camelToUnderscoreCase
methods.description: Converts a camelCase string into an uppercase or lowercase snake_case string.

methods.name: camelToTranslation
methods.description: Generates a translation label from a class name, or returns a prettified version of the class name if no translation is found.

methods.name: explodeCamelCase
methods.description: Splits a camelCase string into its individual components as an array of strings.
